name: Auto actions
description: The AI step after the briefing: every open todo without a button gets ready-made actions from what the installed plugins can do (a message, a comment, a mail draft, a meeting, a hand-over). Its review is a lambda you or the AI can change.
author: Zeff

aiTasks.label: Auto actions
aiTasks.what: Turns todos into ready-made actions (message, comment, mail, meeting, hand-over).
